name: frontend-ai-workflow
description: Reusable frontend delivery with traceable test-case planning, project-native test verification, and project-local deterministic UI review.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap and govern reusable AI workflows for frontend repositories.
interface.longDescription: Inspect frontend repositories, create governed requirements, drive an OpenSpec 1.9 change lifecycle, form traceable TC test plans, implement project-native tests only when requested, gate completion on real evidence, and run portable deterministic UI review without a separate management platform.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this frontend repository with the shared AI workflow.
Turn my feature description into a reviewable requirement document.
Analyze the selected change, form traceable frontend test cases, and implement or verify them only when requested.
